{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/penguins.csv'
penguins = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Drop rows with missing values in the columns of interest
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Compute Pearson correlation
correlation = penguins_clean['flipper_length_mm'].corr(penguins_clean['body_mass_g'])

# Print the result
correlation"}
